one_line: Three questions as a headline, an expert credential label, then an idea every two seconds with a save ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 two stacked Giotto be-bè dough packs, a headline "בצק משחק" "למה, מתי ואיך להשתמש" and a label "מאיה דוסקלוביץ' מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים". Voice (transcript): "בצק משחק. למה? מתי להתחיל? ואיך להשתמש?". 0:04 "תישארו עד הסוף".
q1_hook.why: A headline at 0:00 states the topic and three questions, said and shown together (T3, H6). The product and her credential are in frame at once. "Stay to the end for an ocean of ideas" opens a loop that the idea parade pays off (H5, H2). No face yet.

beats.what: Two Giotto be-bè packs, then a ring of coloured lids; headline, credential label; "ים של רעיונות"
beats.why: Topic, product, authority and a promise

beats.what: Hands open a blue pot and squeeze, tear and knead the dough
Age guide: "אפשר להתחיל לחשוף סביב גיל שנה"; pink dough torn at ten months
Hands press, poke and roll; "בחשיפות הראשוניות... לא ליצור משהו"
Stacked pots; "אני משתמשת בבצק של ג'יוטו"; she holds up a pot and smiles
beats.why: The brand named with a face

beats.what: A toddler pokes sticks into dough and cuts strips with scissors
Rolling pin and cookie cutters on blue dough
Pegs, coin, toy paw prints, hammer, fork, balls hidden in a cup with a spoon
beats.why: The promised ideas, a new one every 2 to 3 s

beats.what: A shark-shaped knife cuts a dough snake; "באתר של סופר קיט"
beats.why: Where to buy, on the last shot

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Spoken and on screen at 0:56, "שימרו את הריל הזה לפעם הבאה שהבצק יוצא לשולחן" (save). Caption lists ideas worth saving. No question, comment or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: "Stay to the end" opens a loop paid by the idea parade at 0:46 to 0:58 (H5, R4). A new picture every 2 s or so keeps it moving (R3, E2), and the list is reusable (R7). It runs 61 s, with about 25 s of explanation before the ideas (R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and on screen 0:55 to 0:58: "שימרו את הריל הזה לפעם הבאה שהבצק יוצא לשולחן". Then 0:58 to 1:00: "את הבצק ניתן למצוא באתר של סופר קיט". Caption: "ניתן למצוא באתר של סופרקיט 🍏". No price, no link.
q3_cta.why: Both lines are said and shown after the value (C6). The save ask has a clear benefit (R7). But two different actions, save and buy, sit in the last 6 s (C1), and "where to buy" has no link or price in the caption.

q4_shown.what: Giotto be-bè packs and pots from 0:00; adult hands doing every action on blue dough; the creator's face and a pot 0:35 to 0:37; a toddler's hands and lower face with sticks and scissors 0:37 to 0:41; tools to 1:00; a credential label. No price.
q4_shown.why: The label gives authority from the first second (S6). The pots are only handled at 0:06, past the 2 s mark (S1), then stay in the corner of the frame, a light brand pulse (H3). Hands carry the demo, with a face only briefly (S4). The toddler's lower face is shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: 27 shots in 61 s, about 2.3 s each, straight cuts, no speed changes seen. Mostly static top-down hands; a talking-head shot at 0:35; a toddler clip 0:37. Voice wall to wall, with short synced subtitles. Ends with the shop name held about 3 s.
q5_edit.why: Text at 0:00 and a cut at 1.7 s open well (E1). A cut every 2 to 3 s inside one scene suits the advised pace (E2). Voice with short synced phrases works muted (E4, T2). It stops right after the shop line (E8).

q6_topic.what: When and how to start play dough with toddlers: from about age one, hands first, then tools and ideas; serves a parent of a toddler.
q6_topic.why: "When can I start" is a real parent question, answered with modest, qualified advice ("זה כמובן תלוי בילד", transcript) (K6, K4). A calm, practical list is worth saving (R7). There is no high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone looking down at a pale wooden table in window light, fixed, adult hands only; an eye-level still life of the packs; a medium shot of the creator behind a row of pots, holding one up; a handheld toddler clip at the same table.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the seat (F5), and dough and tools fill the frame (F4). It is clean, evenly lit and homemade (F7). She faces the lens only once, briefly, at 0:35 (F6).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to 0:05 white bold headline in the upper third: "בצק משחק" "למה, מתי ואיך להשתמש", and a translucent label with her name and "מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים" low in the frame. Then white subtitles with a dark outline, 2 to 4 words, about 70% down: "ים של רעיונות" (0:05), "סביב גיל שנה" (0:14), "שמותאם במיוחד לפעוטות" (0:36), "באתר של סופר קיט" (0:59).
q8_text.caption: "הבצק הוא כלי נהדר ומפתח מיומנויות רבות". About 220 words: age advice, benefit and idea lists, tool list, a recommendation of the Giotto be-bè range with four check marks, where to buy. No hashtags, no question, no partnership wording.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second and short synced subtitles work muted (T3, T1, T2). The subtitles and label sit in the lower area that buttons cover (T4). The caption is full of search words but has no hashtags (T7). Giotto is tagged as a recommendation with no partnership word (T8).

weak_points: No partnership wording although Giotto is a co-author; 61 s; the label and subtitles in the lower area; the 0:41 subtitle "ומלכלך את הבגדים" reads as the opposite of the meaning; no link or price; no hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with three questions as a headline over the book and a credential label, then top-down hands, an idea every 2 s, a save ask at the end.
not_verified: Whether she is paid or gifted by Giotto (co-author listed, nothing on screen says so). The toddler's age and whether it is her child. Music. Whether the woman at 0:35 is the account owner. Correction to coded file: the 0:41 subtitle has no negation, though the speech probably says "ולא מלכלך".
